name: io.github.amkkoussay/mersad
title: Mirsad
description: One shared memory for all your AI agents: bi-temporal facts, first-class decisions with reasons and evidence, and a cross-agent conflict queue the owner resolves. Local-first, single SQLite file.

environmentVariables.name: MIRSAD_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport to serve: stdio for MCP clients (use this), streamable-http for the local web viewer.

environmentVariables.name: MIRSAD_DB
environmentVariables.description: Path to the SQLite memory file (created if missing).
